evidence.title: A Source-Grounded Framework for Constructing and Evaluating Progressive Multimodal Diagnostic Dialogues from Clinical Case Reports

summary: Researchers propose a method to build and evaluate AI-driven diagnostic conversations using clinical case reports, enhancing accuracy with multimodal and progressive dialogue structures. The framework aims to improve AI-assisted medical diagnostics by grounding responses in verified sources.
title: New Framework Introduces Source-Grounded Progressive Multimodal Diagnostic Dialogues for Clinical AI
